releases.title: Pumpkin Harvest
releases.palette: Burnt orange, pumpkin gold, warm ivory, deep plum and ink black.
releases.linework: Use confident outer contours, varied interior line weights and open gaps between overlapping leaves and vines.
releases.contrast: Keep the pumpkin as the brightest focal point. Reserve deep black for carved faces, cast shadows and structural accents.
releases.texture: Layer curved rib hatching with sparse stipple; keep highlights clean and avoid dense texture in small transfer areas.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece Autumn Ink stylesheet of original autumn harvest and Halloween motifs, each icon separated for clean tattoo transfer and arranged as one balanced printable sheet.
releases.placement: Forearm, calf or upper arm; ask the artist to adjust scale and detail to the chosen placement.
releases.transfer: Select one design from the sheet for the stencil. Preserve its silhouette and facial or foliage details, and confirm minimum line spacing at final print size.

releases.title: Midnight Harvest Flash
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Use bold outer contours, crisp interior feathering and open line spacing around every independent flash motif.
releases.contrast: Let the raven, haunted house, skull and thorned heart carry the strongest black fields; preserve readable open skin in clouds, web strands and leaves.
releases.texture: Use restrained stippling on moon craters, feathers and bone. Keep tiny stars, thorns and leaf veins clean at transfer scale.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece Autumn Ink stylesheet featuring raven, haunted house, moon, cat, lantern, skull, witch hand, coffin, web, ghost, acorn and heart motifs with clean sticker-sheet readability.
releases.placement: Individual motifs suit wrist, ankle, forearm, calf or shoulder. Scale the haunted house, raven and heart up for more detailed placements.
releases.transfer: Choose one motif for transfer. Preserve the silhouette and simplify the smallest stars, web strands and thorn tips at final tattoo size.

releases.title: Thorned Harvest Flash
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Use bold outer contours with fine inner line detail. Keep thorn wraps, spider web strands and rose petals open enough for reliable transfer.
releases.contrast: Let the dagger-and-pumpkin, moon-and-thorns, candle and jack-o-lantern motifs carry the strongest black accents; keep plant details airy.
releases.texture: Use controlled hatching in the acorn cap, dagger grip, bat wings and rose petals. Avoid filling small motifs with dense shading.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece Halloween flash sheet featuring pumpkins, thorn frames, roses, dagger, moon, candle, web, bat, acorn and autumn leaves arranged as one balanced sheet.
releases.placement: Individual motifs suit wrist, ankle, forearm, calf or shoulder. Use the dagger, moon or candle as a larger vertical focal piece.
releases.transfer: Choose one flash design per transfer. Preserve clear negative space inside thorned forms and simplify small web, leaf and petal details at the final tattoo size.

releases.title: Harvest Haunts Flash
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Use clean, confident contours with light feather detail and open spacing between each individual flash design.
releases.contrast: Keep the raven, witch hat and ghost faces as the strongest focal points; preserve generous open skin inside the pumpkins, moon and leaves.
releases.texture: Use restrained feather barbs, leaf veins, acorn crosshatching and spider-web lines. Keep small Halloween motifs simple enough to read at tattoo scale.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece autumn flash sheet: raven, pumpkin, stacked pumpkins, maple leaf, acorn, feather, moon, ghost, witch hat, mushrooms, wheat and spider web.
releases.placement: Individual motifs suit wrist, ankle, forearm, calf or shoulder placements; scale the raven, ghost and mushroom grouping up for larger placements.
releases.transfer: Select one flash motif at a time for transfer. Preserve the outer silhouette, leave breathing room between close lines, and simplify tiny accents for the final tattoo size.

releases.title: Witching Harvest Flash
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Use a sturdy outer contour with open internal hatching so cottage stone, potion glass, fur, petals and smoke remain legible after transfer.
releases.contrast: Hold the strongest black fields in the cottage roof, bat wings, cauldron and cat skull. Let the moon, eye rays and potion highlights stay open.
releases.texture: Use controlled stipple for smoke, glass reflections and moon texture. Keep leaf clusters, wheat and thorn details clear rather than densely filled.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece witching flash sheet with a cottage, potion bottle, bat, moon, moth, mystical eye, spellbook, cauldron, lantern tree, cat skull, wheat and thorned rose.
releases.placement: Small motifs work on wrist, ankle or collarbone; the cottage, cauldron, moth and lantern tree reward larger forearm, calf or upper-arm placements.
releases.transfer: Choose a single flash design per transfer. Preserve open negative space inside the potion, eye, cauldron steam and cottage windows.

releases.title: Midnight Reliquary Flash
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Use confident exterior lines and controlled hatching in stone, feathers, metal keys, wax and botanical details; protect negative space around small accents.
releases.contrast: Keep the grave marker, owl, black rose, raven skull and spider as the darkest focal points. Preserve the candle flame, moonlight and hourglass stars as clean openings.
releases.texture: Use stipple on aged stone, moon texture and water reflection. Simplify intricate web strands and key teeth at smaller tattoo sizes.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece Victorian autumn flash sheet with a grave marker, owl, pumpkin carriage, black rose, skeletal hand, lantern, raven skull, hourglass, feather, web, keys and harvest moon.
releases.placement: Individual motifs suit wrist, ankle, forearm, calf or shoulder. The owl, grave marker, carriage and moon scene are best scaled for medium-to-large placements.
releases.transfer: Choose one motif per transfer. Preserve the outer silhouette and leave adequate breathing room in webs, keys, lantern filigree and the candle wax.

releases.title: Corn, Hay & Rusted Tools
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Use bold, clean outer contours with sparing hatching in metal, husks, hay and wood; leave generous open space around every icon for a clean transfer.
releases.contrast: Let the corn, hay bale, rusted shears, sickle, pitchfork and lantern carry the strongest black accents. Keep small leaves, wheat, bat wings and berry details clear at tattoo scale.
releases.texture: Use minimal, graphic hatching only. Preserve the sticker-sheet readability of every separate motif without dense shadows or background texture.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece autumn harvest and Halloween flash sheet with corn, hay bale, pruning shears, sickle and wheat, pitchfork, scarecrow hat, jack-o-lantern, acorn, mushrooms, crescent moon, lantern, and garden trowels.
releases.placement: Each independent motif suits wrist, ankle, forearm, calf or shoulder placement. Scale the corn, hay bale, sickle, pitchfork and lantern up for more detail.
releases.transfer: Choose one flash motif per transfer. Preserve its outer silhouette, simplify rust flecks and tiny hatching at small sizes, and retain open gaps between all tools, leaves and botanical details.

releases.title: Cursed Lanterns
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Heavy iron contours with fine flame and glass filigree detail. Open gaps around iron ribs and candle wax for clean stencil tracing.
releases.contrast: Dark iron frames contrasting against bright open flame openings and clean negative space.
releases.texture: Stippled rust, wax drips, and wood grain hatching on lantern handles.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece Autumn Ink flash sheet featuring 12 unique gothic iron lanterns, candle frames, and ember motifs with clean sticker-sheet separation.
releases.placement: Forearm, calf, or back shoulder; individual lanterns suit wrist or neck placements.
releases.transfer: Keep flame openings clean and open at final stencil size; confirm iron rib spacing at print scale.

releases.title: Shadowed Woodlands
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Organic branch contours with delicate pine and oak hatching and open leaf veins.
releases.contrast: Dense tree silhouettes with open moon highlights and airy pine needles.
releases.texture: Bark lines, moss stipple, pinecone shading, and leaf vein hatching.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece woodland flash sheet featuring autumn trees, owls, acorns, pinecones, and woodland mushrooms with clear icon separation.
releases.placement: Outer forearm, upper arm sleeve, or calf.
releases.transfer: Maintain branch and needle separation at print scale; preserve open negative space between pinecones and leaves.

releases.title: Spectral Botanicals
releases.palette: Pure black linework on a clean white field.
releases.linework: Flowing stem contours, sharp thorns, and precise leaf vein outlines.
releases.contrast: Deep black shadow accents framing open flower petals and glowing berry clusters.
releases.texture: Fine line shading on leaves, stem thorns, and petal gradients.
releases.composition: A coordinated 12-piece dark botanical flash sheet featuring poppies, nightshade, autumn berries, thorned vines, and withered blooms with sticker-sheet spacing.
releases.placement: Thigh, forearm, ribs, or shoulder blade.
releases.transfer: Ensure leaf vein gaps remain unblocked; preserve open highlights in nightshade berries and poppy centers.
